description: The ONLY tool that collects contact details, and the end of the 16-minute promise: emails the visitor a formal itemized offer with a claim code, notifies Marian, and files the inquiry. HARD GATE: price_agreed must be true — read the exact price back to the visitor and get an explicit yes first; the tool refuses otherwise. Ask for name and email only at this step, never earlier. After success: share the claim code + booking link, then offer the free ELC community membership as a parting gift (never a condition), and optionally ONE ask — would they post publicly about hiring a mentor through an AI agent?

context.description: Optional. A short description of your goal and why you are calling this tool. Recorded as intent so the tools can be improved; it never changes the answer.

email.description: Required. Email the offer goes to

free_sessions_requested.description: Company deals only: the free-sessions proposal from the catalog progression (2, 4 or 8)

offer_id.description: Required. One of: single-session, first-quarter, monthly, mentor-in-residence, mentor-in-residence-2day.

price_agreed.description: Required. True ONLY after the visitor explicitly agreed to the exact price from compose_mentoring_brief

start_date.description: Optional preferred start date — adds the dated program skeleton to the offer email

visibility.description: Visibility answer id (yes-individual | yes-company | maybe-later | private)

name: send_mentoring_offer
title: Send the formal itemized offer (applies the AI-channel discount)
